integrity: Proof and embedded standalone finite checker correspond to this claim; all infinite statements are established symbolically rather than inferred from finite tests.
scientific_limitations: Only finite dihedral 0-Hecke monoids. The proof relies on alternating normal forms; the limiting law is also known in a different semigroup family. No higher-rank extension or independent priority assessment is asserted.
title: Power-map fiber rigidity and a harmonic absorption law in dihedral 0-Hecke monoids
